THE UNFOLDING · THE READING HEARD WHOLE
A complete reading, all twenty-seven cards each exactly once, laid out by pitch (the spectral centroid of the same voice the figures sound) and by time-band: root, present, becoming. A solid line joins counters; a dashed line points a card to its becoming. SOUND THE READING plays it as three phrases, each band in the order it was dealt, one card to a breath: the Seed alone is a rest, for only the unstruck have no voice, and the four Silences ring like any card, unsayable but not unsound. The air line below measures the whole procession's beating as it passes. Beneath the lattice the whole field is counted: cards at home, the hand's parity, and the deal's own return period, the same arithmetic the reading bench reads at twenty-seven. A fresh unfolding is composed for the bench; paste a declared seed to hear a committed cast replayed.
DERIVED, NEVER TUNED · SILENT UNTIL TOUCHED · RETIRED TO THE WORKSHOP'S SHELF
